name: Track Global
author: Track.Global

sections.description:
The Track.Global plugin is an easy-to-use tool that allows your users to quickly and easily check the status of their shipments without leaving your website.

Benefits:
* Increase user engagement: By offering a convenient tracking tool, you enhance the user experience, fostering loyalty and encouraging repeat visits.
* Improve behavioral metrics: Keep visitors on your site longer, positively impacting your website’s search engine rankings.
* Easy integration: Set up the plugin in just a few clicks. Customize the widget by selecting the language, width, height, and display type.

How to use:
* Install and activate the plugin.
* Configure the widget settings.
* Insert the generated shortcode into the desired location on your site (e.g., a post or page).
sections.installation:
Installing “Track Global” can be done either by searching for “Track Global” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload’ screen in your WordPress dashboard
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
